eyebrow: Four settings that cap what a container can do
code:
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
containers:
  - securityContext:
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      capabilities:
        drop: ["ALL"]
caption: Non-root, no privilege escalation, no writable filesystem, no extra Linux capabilities — checkout's hardened baseline.

eyebrow: Enforced at the namespace, not per-Pod
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: checkout
  labels:
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted
caption: A Pod that doesn't meet "restricted" is rejected by the API server before it's ever scheduled.
